description: Glass fibres; mechanically bonded fabrics and closed woven fabrics, plain weave, of yarns, not coated or laminated (other than rovings)

predecessors.note: HS 2022 rebuilt the glass-fibre fabric subheadings (7019.61 to 7019.69). Earlier trade sat across 7019.40 to 7019.59 with no single predecessor.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
